WE6_boundary.statement: The honest 40-point graph action constructed here is PSp(4,3), order 25920. W(E6), order 51840, is an index-two phase/Weyl extension and is not promoted here to a second faithful point-graph action.
WE6_boundary.consequence: Primitive W33 graph cycles have PSp(4,3) orbit classes. A W(E6)-equivariant classification requires a separately specified phase-lifted carrier; doubling the group order alone does not create new graph automorphisms.
WE6_boundary.large_length_policy: Pass 1195 gives exact primitive counts through length 40. Individual orbit enumeration beyond length 4 is astronomically large and is not falsely claimed.
